pactoVersion.description: The version of the Pacto contract specification this file conforms to.

service.description: Identifies the service: its name, version, and owner.

name.description: A unique, DNS-compatible identifier for the service (lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens).

version.description: The current version of the service, typically following semantic versioning.

owner.description: Structured ownership metadata in a provider-neutral format.

team.description: The canonical team that owns the service.

dri.description: The directly responsible individual for this service.

contacts.description: Provider-neutral ownership and escalation contact points. The list is a set: order carries no meaning, and repeating an identical contact point names the same one contact point rather than adding another.

value.description: The contact value, such as an email address, URL, or group identifier.

purpose.description: The intended operational purpose of this contact point.

interfaces.description: The network interfaces the service exposes. Each interface declares its spec-kind (openapi, asyncapi, grpc) and references the spec file within the bundle.

name.description: A unique name for this interface within the service.

ref.description: Path to the interface spec file in the bundle.

visibility.description: Controls who can reach this interface.

x-enum-descriptions.public: accessible from outside the cluster or network boundary
x-enum-descriptions.internal: only accessible within the cluster or internal network

configurations.description: Named configuration sources. Each entry is an independent named scope with no implicit merge semantics.

name.description: A unique name for this configuration scope.

schema.description: Path to a JSON Schema file describing configuration properties (within the bundle).

ref.description: OCI or local reference to another Pacto contract whose bundle contains the configuration schema.

values.description: Configuration values to be validated against the configuration schema. Only allowed with schema.

required.description: Whether this configuration is mandatory. If true, its confirmed absence at runtime is a violation; if false it is optional.

policies.description: Policy constraints for the contract. Each entry defines or references a JSON Schema that validates the contract itself, enabling platform teams to enforce organizational standards. Multiple policies apply with strict AND semantics.

name.description: A unique name for this policy within the contract.

schema.description: Path to a JSON Schema file within the bundle that defines policy constraints (convention: policy/schema.json).

ref.description: OCI or local reference to another Pacto contract whose bundle contains the policy schema at the fixed path policy/schema.json.

target.description: The evaluation target for this policy. Currently only 'contract' is supported.

dependencies.description: Other services this service depends on. Each dependency references another service's published Pacto contract.

name.description: A unique name for this dependency within the contract (typically the service name).

ref.description: An OCI reference to the dependency's published Pacto contract (e.g. ghcr.io/org/service-pacto@sha256:...).

required.description: Whether this dependency is mandatory. If true, the service cannot function without it; if false, the service degrades gracefully when it is unavailable.

compatibility.description: A semver range expressing which versions of the dependency this service is compatible with (e.g. ^2.0.0, ~1.3.0).

state.description: Declares how the service manages state, including whether it retains data, how that data is persisted, and how critical the data is.

type.description: Whether the service needs data from a previous request to handle the current one.

x-enum-descriptions.stateless: does not retain data between requests; any instance can handle any request (e.g. an API proxy or a service whose in-memory data can be fully rebuilt from external sources)
x-enum-descriptions.stateful: retains data between requests and requires stable storage or affinity (e.g. a database, a message broker, or a service with on-disk state)
x-enum-descriptions.hybrid: handles requests statelessly but keeps selective in-memory or local state that enriches behaviour (e.g. an API with a local cache, in-memory session store, or background-refreshed data)

persistence.description: Describes the scope and durability of the service's persisted data.

scope.description: Whether data is confined to a single instance or shared across instances.

x-enum-descriptions.local: data is confined to a single instance and not shared across replicas (e.g. in-memory caches, local files, embedded databases)
x-enum-descriptions.shared: data is shared across all instances via a common store (e.g. a database, Redis, or shared filesystem)

durability.description: Whether the data survives process restarts.

x-enum-descriptions.ephemeral: data can be lost on restart without impact; used for in-memory caches, temp files, or reconstructible state
x-enum-descriptions.persistent: data must survive restarts and be durably stored (e.g. on disk, in a database, or in an external store)

dataCriticality.description: The business impact of losing this service's data.

x-enum-descriptions.low: loss of data has minimal business impact; can be regenerated or is non-essential
x-enum-descriptions.medium: loss of data has moderate business impact and may require manual recovery
x-enum-descriptions.high: loss of data has severe business impact and must be prevented (e.g. financial records)

workload.description: The execution pattern of the workload.

x-enum-descriptions.service: a long-running process that serves requests continuously
x-enum-descriptions.job: a one-shot task that runs to completion and then exits
x-enum-descriptions.scheduled: a task that runs on a recurring schedule (e.g. cron)

capabilities.description: Standard observability capabilities or custom extensions.

type.description: The capability type. 'health' and 'metrics' are standard; 'extension' requires a namespaced ref.

ref.description: Required for extension capabilities. Must be a namespaced identifier (e.g. 'example.com/custom').

binding.description: Binds a standard capability endpoint to a declared interface. Only http is supported this release.

interface.description: Name of the declared interface that owns this endpoint (must match an interfaces[].name).

path.description: Optional application path on the owning interface (must start with a single '/'; no scheme/host/userinfo/fragment).

minScore.description: Gate threshold; the derived score must be at least this (default 100).

expires.description: Assessment-level expiry (YYYY-MM-DD). When passed, all in-scope claims are expired.

partialCredit.description: Fraction of weight a 'partial' claim earns (default 0.5).

metadata.description: A free-form object for attaching custom key-value metadata to the service contract.

extensions.description: A free-form object for attaching custom extensions to the service contract.
